comment: Mononuclear non-heme iron enzyme with high substrate- and reaction promiscuity, including halogenation (Cl, Br), oxygenation, and vinyl-chloride formation. Consists of unusual three-domain structure with N-terminal catalytic halogenase domain, an ACBP, and an substrate-anchoring ACP.

reactions.description: Bicyclic halogenation through C5 radical intermediate product in the hectochlorin biosynthetic pathway.
C5 dichlorination of fatty acyl substrate.
Bicyclic halogenation and dehydrogenation through C5 radical intermediate product  in the hectochlorin biosynthetic pathway.
Single C5 chlorination and C4, C5 dehydrogenation resulting in a vinyl-chloride product of fatty acyl substrate.
Bicyclic monooxygenation through C5 radical intermediate product  in the hectochlorin biosynthetic pathway.
C5 monoxygenation of fatty acyl substrate, resulting in keto-moiety.
